title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Special Financing Schedule: Promotional Add-On to a Catch-Up Payment
content:
**Schedule rule.** For a catch-up payment on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the promotional add-on is set by the special financing still running: when the latest statement shows a promotional balance and no more than 2 full calendar months of the promotion remain, it is the whole promotional balance; when it shows a promotional balance and more months remain, it is the promotional balance divided by the full calendar months remaining, rounded half up to the cent; when there is no promotional balance there is no add-on. The months remaining are the card's promotion length in months less the full calendar months since the transaction date of the most recent special financing purchase. The promotional add-on is added into the catch-up amount before the most recent payment credited after the missed due date is subtracted, the floor at zero applied and the result rounded.

## Promotion length by card

| Card | Promotion length (months) |
|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card, Store Card Plus, Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard | 12 |
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite, World Elite Mastercard | 18 |

## Schedule

| Promotional balance on the latest statement | Full calendar months remaining | Promotional add-on |
|---|---|---|
| above zero | 2 or fewer | the whole promotional balance |
| above zero | more than 2 | the promotional balance divided by the months remaining, rounded half up to the cent |
| none | — | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical promotional balance USD 1200.00)

| Card's promotion length | Full months since the most recent special financing purchase | Months remaining | Add-on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 11 | 1 | USD 1200.00 |
| 12 | 10 | 2 | USD 1200.00 |
| 12 | 6 | 6 | USD 200.00 |
| 18 | 7 | 11 | 1200.00 divided by 11 is 109.0909: USD 109.09 |

With USD 55.00 owed before the add-on, an add-on of USD 200.00 and a most recent payment of USD 20.00 credited after the missed due date, the amount is 55.00 plus 200.00 less 20.00: USD 235.00.
